iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: Pembina's Pacific Link Role Could Transform Canada's Oil Access
top.summary: Pembina Pipeline Corporation has reached a significant milestone with the Pacific Link pipeline project, which has been designated a Project of National Interest by the Government of Canada. The pipeline could transport up to 1 million barrels of crude daily from Alberta to Asia-Pacific markets, potentially generating over $20 billion in annual GDP and creating up to 140,000 jobs. Pembina will contribute development expertise with a 10% economic interest during construction while retaining full discretion over its final investment decision.

top.title: Petrobras Scores Second Oil Find in Foz do Amazonas Basin
top.summary: Petrobras announced a second oil discovery at the Morpho exploration well in Brazil's Foz do Amazonas Basin, confirming light oil presence in deeper formations. The discovery strengthens exploration potential in the Equatorial Margin region, with three additional wells planned to begin drilling in early 2027. Petrobras has allocated $2.5 billion for 15 exploration wells in the region as part of its 2026-2030 strategic plan.

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: Deadline Alert: Lincoln Educational Services Corporation (LINC) Shareholders Who Lost Money Urged To Contact Glancy Prongay Wolke & Rotter LLP About Securities Fraud Lawsuit
top.summary: Lincoln Educational Services Corporation (LINC) is facing a class action securities fraud lawsuit for allegedly making false statements about its business between May 11 and August 9, 2026. The company failed to disclose that its admissions process was not effectively converting enrolled students to actual class attendees, resulting in only 1% student start growth despite 9% enrollment growth. The stock fell 24.93% on August 10, 2026 when the company disclosed these issues. Investors have until November 10, 2026 to file a lead plaintiff motion.

top.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges Lincoln Educational Services Corporation Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
top.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Lincoln Educational Services Corporation (NASDAQ: LINC) alleging securities fraud. The complaint claims the company made false statements about its business operations, specifically regarding ineffective student conversion from enrollment to start, resulting in significant drops in student starts. Investors who purchased securities between May 11, 2026 and August 9, 2026 may be eligible to join the case, with a lead plaintiff deadline of November 10, 2026.

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options neutral
iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.summary: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against Unicycive Therapeutics, Inc. (UNCY) for allegedly making materially false and misleading statements regarding its third-party manufacturing vendor's FDA compliance. The lawsuit claims the company failed to disclose that it had not inspected the vendor's facility or audited its compliance with manufacturing practices, creating undisclosed risks of regulatory delays for its oxylanthanum carbonate drug. Investors who purchased UNCY securities between December 29, 2025 and June 29, 2026 may be eligible for compensation. The lead plaintiff deadline is November 2, 2026.

vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。
